fl_berberine.name: Berberine Pro
fl_berberine.key: Per capsule: 100 mg dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) + 84 mg organic Ceylon cinnamon bark extract
fl_berberine.src: Label: Berberine Pro sell sheet ND1130 Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Berberine Pro SS ND1130.pdf, re-read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 90 servings: Dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg; Organic Cinnamon Extract (bark; Cinnamomum ceylon) 84 mg. Directions: 'Take one capsule three times daily before meals or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Caution: 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' (the source of the sheet's pregnancy line). Same amounts in products DB R2125 (DFH, Ortho and Thorne chart reads of catalog ND143 10/1/26); size R2125 90C on the 10/1/26 price list. Protocol: NutriDyn CSO GLC 2026 'Metabolic Fatty Liver (MAFLD, MASLD, MASH)' list (GLC 2026 protocol PDF). The daily rhythm has no midday slot, so the breakfast and lunch doses share the first box, which this sheet labels 'Breakfast and lunch' (the insulin-resistance sheet also puts the lunch capsule in its first box), and the dinner dose sits in the Evening meal box: 3 a day, the label dose. URL: Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact links https://nutridyn.com/berberine-pro.

fl_lipo_flow.name: Lipo-Flow
fl_lipo_flow.key: Per 2 tablets: 400 mg artichoke, 250 mg dandelion, 200 mg beet, 150 mg inositol, 100 mg each of tangerine peel, gentian, taurine and methionine
fl_lipo_flow.src: Label: Lipo-Flow sell sheet ND606 Rev. 4/26 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Lipo-Flow SS ND606.pdf, re-read 2026-11-04; the same panel is in the products DB R863). Supplement Facts, serving 2 tablets, 90 servings: Artichoke Extract (aerial parts) 400 mg, Dandelion Extract (root) 250 mg, Beet Powder (root) 200 mg, Inositol 150 mg, Tangerine Extract (peel; Citrus reticulata) 100 mg, Gentian Extract (root) 100 mg, Taurine 100 mg, L-Methionine 100 mg. Directions: 'Take two tablets with a meal three times daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The sheet prints that label dose (2 tablets 3 times daily with meals = 6 a day; 2 at breakfast and 2 at lunch in the Breakfast and lunch box, 2 at dinner in the Evening meal box). A lower option exists if fewer pills are wanted: the NutriDyn science-team lipotropic protocol in Asher's protocol email to a practitioner, 2024-09-24, reads '1-2 tablets 3 times daily with meals' (lipotropics 'to promote healthy liver function'). Size R863 180T (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Sell-sheet claims: 'Support for Healthy Fat Metabolism', 'Promote healthy bile processes'. Bile, the source of the check panel's gallstone line (polish round 2): 'Lipo-Flow provides choleretic and cholagogue gastrointestinal agents' and 'Cholagogue agents promote the healthy flow of bile from the liver and gall bladder into the intestines'; artichoke and beet are choleretic and cholagogue, dandelion, tangerine and gentian cholagogue (ND606). Artichoke products 'should not be used by individuals with bile duct obstruction, including those with gallstones' (Silva H, Daia AM, Biology (Basel) 2025;14(4):397, PMC12024969). Artichoke and dandelion are daisy-family (Asteraceae) plants, hence the line's ragweed-or-daisy allergy (the module's [GILLESSEN20] note). Chosen for the competitor's 'bergamot + artichoke' column: artichoke plus a citrus peel extract. Photo: 348x640 soft 4x stopgap; print master Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R863_Web, not downloadable from this session. URL: products.py SLUGS lipo_flow.

fl_milk_thistle.name: Milk Thistle Complex
fl_milk_thistle.key: Per capsule: 375 mg milk thistle extract (80% silymarin), 300 mg silymarin, 50 mg NAC, 25 mg each of turmeric and artichoke
fl_milk_thistle.src: Label: Milk Thistle Complex sell sheet ND764 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Milk Thistle Complex SS ND764.pdf, re-read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 60 servings, each line with its own %DV asterisk: Milk Thistle Extract (seed; Silybum marianum; standardized to 80% silymarin) 375 mg; Silymarin (from milk thistle seed extract) 300 mg; N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine 50 mg; Turmeric Extract (root; standardized to 95% curcuminoids) 25 mg; Artichoke Extract (leaf and stem; standardized to 5% cynarin) 25 mg; Superoxide Dismutase (bovine) 5 mg; Beet Root Powder 5 mg; Boron (as boron glycinate) 250 mcg. OPEN QUESTION FOR NUTRIDYN, total silymarin per capsule, 300 or 600 mg? The sources disagree: 375 mg x 80% = 300 mg exactly, and products DB R416 (Integrative Therapeutics chart) reads the panel as 'NutriDyn 300 mg (1 capsule, 375 mg extract at 80%)', i.e. the 300 mg is the extract's own silymarin; but the sell sheet prose says 'Milk thistle, with additional bioactive silymarin added to the formula', which reads as 300 mg on top. Until NutriDyn confirms, the page mirrors the panel line by line, amount first like the other three columns, and states no total (2026-11-03 polish: the '(label)' tag is gone); if the DB reading is confirmed, print '375 mg milk thistle extract (300 mg silymarin), 50 mg NAC, 25 mg each of turmeric and artichoke'. The page line stops at artichoke for space; SOD, beet root and boron are in the formula too. Directions: 'Take one capsule twice daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Sell-sheet claims used on the page: 'Promote healthy liver function'; 'promoting the liver's natural detoxification processes'; 'potent antioxidant ingredients'. Size R416 60C. Protocol: NutriDyn CSO GLC 2026 'Metabolic Fatty Liver' list. Stands in for the competitor's aged black garlic (antioxidant liver-cell support). Check panel (polish round 2): milk thistle and artichoke are daisy-family (Asteraceae) plants, and with milk thistle 'caution is advised in patients with a known sensitivity to plants in the Asteraceae/Compositae family (members of this family include chrysanthemums, daisies, marigolds and ragweed)' (Gillessen A, Schmidt HH, Adv Ther 2020;37(4):1279-1301, PMC7140758); its 25 mg artichoke extract is choleretic (PMC12024969), so the gallstone and ragweed-or-daisy line names Milk Thistle Complex next to Lipo-Flow. Photo: only the 89x160 web thumbnail is available here; the print master is Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R416_Web, which this session could not download (dl.dropboxusercontent.com refused by the network policy). URL: Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact links https://nutridyn.com/milk-thistle-complex-r416. Rhythm: the sheet's first box holds breakfast and lunch doses, so the morning capsule says 'at breakfast' (the label gives no meal; the column's 'morning and evening' stays); the evening capsule sits in the Evening meal box.

fl_mito.name: Mito Recharge
fl_mito.key: Per 3 capsules: 75 mg alpha-lipoic + 45 mg R-lipoic acid, 100 mg each of CoQ10, NAC and EGCG (green tea), 250 mcg vitamin K1
fl_mito.src: Label: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Mito Recharge SS ND812.pdf, re-read 2026-11-03). Supplement Facts, serving 3 capsules, 30 servings: vitamin C 150 mg, vitamin E 25 mg, vitamin K1 (phytonadione) 250 mcg, thiamin 25 mg, riboflavin 12 mg, niacin 12 mg NE, B6 (P5P) 7.5 mg, magnesium 75 mg, selenium 25 mcg, taurine 300 mg, acetyl-L-carnitine HCl 200 mg, resveratrol 100 mg, coenzyme Q10 100 mg, N-acetyl-L-cysteine 100 mg, EGCG (from green tea extract; leaf) 100 mg, quercetin 100 mg, alpha-lipoic acid 75 mg, R-alpha-lipoic acid 45 mg, sulforaphane glucosinolate 15 mg, hydroxytyrosol 10 mg, PQQ 7 mg. Directions: 'Take three capsules daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The label's caution is the generic one (pregnant, nursing or taking medication); it carries no green tea extract wording. The line names EGCG and vitamin K1 because the Pharmacist/Provider check relies on them: K1 works against warfarin (NIH ODS vitamin K fact sheet); green tea extract is taken with food, never fasting, and stopped if liver symptoms appear, per the USP green tea extract review (Oketch-Rabah HA, Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402, doi:10.1016/j.toxrep.2020.02.008: fasting bolus doses raise EGCG exposure; caution 'especially when ingested under fasting conditions or in cases where there is underlying liver vulnerability'). Taken with breakfast for that reason. OPEN QUESTION FOR ASHER OR THE CSO: this is a green-tea-extract product on a liver sheet. The USP review says the public should be warned 'especially [about] those who are obese or have preexisting liver disease', and the USP monograph label caution says 'Do not use if you have a liver problem' (full text and provenance in the module's [USP20] note). Kept for now because it is on the CSO's GLC 2026 fatty-liver list, and because the reviewer's default swap, Alpha-Lipoic Acid R270 (200 mg per capsule, SS ND283 Rev. 8/24), has no real photo: the only R270 image in reach shows the Progressive P872 bottle. The check panel therefore says that with fatty liver or any liver problem it is taken only if the provider (pharmacy edition: the doctor) says so, always with food. Decide keep or swap before print; a swap needs the real R270 bottle photo first. KEEP PATH, printed from polish round 2 until the CSO decides: the gate also sits where the reader builds the plan. The rhythm note (back['rhythm_note']) says to add Mito Recharge last, only once the provider writes it in the box below (pharmacy edition: once the doctor says yes), and the practitioner edition's check asks for that written yes in the Special considerations box instead of 'says so', which the handout used to meet by itself. SWAP PATH, if the CSO chooses it: Alpha-Lipoic Acid R270 (200 mg per capsule, 1 daily, SS ND283 Rev. 8/24) once the real R270 bottle photo is in hand; then delete the green tea check and the vitamin K1 clause, and the plan drops to 12 pills. Size R167 90C. Protocol: NutriDyn CSO GLC 2026 'Metabolic Fatty Liver' list. Own key (fl_mito) so the lyme sheet's override of 'mito' never changes this page. Photo: 356x640 soft 4x stopgap; print master Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R167_Web, not downloadable from this session. URL: products.py SLUGS mito. Rhythm: 'at breakfast' in the sheet's first box, which also holds the lunch doses.
